minimum_profile: The public codec/locale APIs compile with tablecraft-expressions --no-default-features; SQL-enabled evaluator tests are a separate check.
counting_note: All five query targets ran together after the test-input correction; no passing subset from the failed attempt is counted again. The expression SQL StrConv filter includes five new codec tests and twenty existing tests.

excluded_attempts.command: cargo test -p tablecraft-query --test strconv_japanese --test strconv --test strconv_options --test strconv_kana --test strconv_width -j2 --locked --offline
excluded_attempts.reason: Two new query tests constructed multibyte inputs by joining odd-length ChrB values with &, which the established UTF16-unit concatenation contract refuses before the codec. Tests now use even packed ChrW units and active ranges, and explicitly preserve the odd-join refusal. No production change or relaxed concatenation rule was required.

review: The fourteen existing locale identities and single-byte CharacterCodePage/LocaleProfile APIs remain unchanged; complete string APIs represent Japanese encoding without dummy legacy accessors.
The maintained encoding_rs codec uses non-replacing fixed-stack token conversions plus exact Unicode encode round-trip admission; yen/overline/minus aliases refuse.
Raw String64/128 active ranges, explicit Binary64, strict final publication, source/flag/locale eagerness and caller-owned budgets/cancellation retain their established boundaries.
Japanese casing+encoding follows the existing decode-before-casing / encode-after-casing pipeline, with explicit call-local locale selection.
Only module/enum Rustdoc wording changed after these Rust checks; no runtime or test behavior changed. Parent integration records final formatting/CLI checks separately.
reference_distribution: Primary reference files remain private ignored inputs. Unicode/WHATWG provenance and licensing were reviewed and documented in JAPANESE_STRING_ENCODING.md; no mapping table or third-party implementation is copied into production or redistributed. Production uses the existing encoding_rs dependency.
